_readme: Browserless read-only captures from the designated Cloudflared Web GUI ingress target.
Never click Save, Save & Restart, Restart Add-on, Authorize, Delete, Download, or any control that mutates or exports state.
Published captures cover navigation and Dashboard status only; sensitive Setup, Config and Logs content is intentionally not captured.
